item.title: Meowdoro 0.1.22
item.description: • A question you've read stops calling. When a session's turn ends on a question, it waits in orange and counts on the cat. Once you open that session in Claude Desktop, on this Mac or on a remote machine, or click its row in the island, the row stays, orange and with the question, but dims and no longer counts. It goes when you answer. A request for permission still counts until you answer it in the session.
